lines: #That business that didn't work? Now you know what customers *don't* want.
That relationship that ended? Now you know what you *need.*
That plan that fell apart? Now you know where the *cracks* were.
#Every scientist fails a hundred times before they find the *answer.*
#So why are you so hard on *yourself?*
Why does one bad result make you want to give up *everything?*
Look at it like a scientist.
Each attempt gets you closer. Even when it *hurts.*
#The only real failure is learning nothing.
end: Save this for the next time something doesn't work.

post.title: You Didn't Fail. You Collected Data.
post.caption: Failure only becomes failure when you stop. Run the next experiment. 🔬
post.first_comment: What's one 'failure' that taught you the most? 👇
